page.overview:
Who is Jana Park?

Jana Park was a Starfleet officer in the 24th century.

In 2364, as a captain, she was the commander of the . Prior to stardate 41603, she put in a request to Starfleet Command for a refit of her ship's transporter system.

Between SD 41603 and 41630, she received three orders from Admiral Gregory Quinn of Starfleet Operational Support Services informing her that Starfleet Command was in the process of evaluating her request and had not reached a consensus. (, okudagram)
